EXTRAORDINARY
THE LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460)
AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964
Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. :KUDS/LND/1/ACQ/04. Land Ministry’s Ref. No. :4/3/15/2012/VE/240.

I, hereby give notice, under Sub-section (1) of Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended by the Land Acquisition (Amendment) Act, No. 28 of 1964, that the Government intends to acquire the following land/servitude which is required for a public purpose:-

Description of the Land or servitude to be acquired: Following Lots of Sheet No. 16 of F.V.P. 359 situated in the village of Millawitiya in North Uda Paththuwa in Kuruwita Korale in the Divisional Secretary’s Division of Kuruwita of Rathnapura District in Sabaragamuwa Province.
01. Lot No. 422 Name of Land: Malebeddahena; Previous Claimant: T. R. Ranjan Keerthi; Present Claimant: Government; Extent: 0.0034 Hectare.
02. Lot No. 423 Name of Land: Malebeddahena; Previous Claimant: Land Reforms Commission; Present Claimant: Government; Extent: 4.3900 Hectare.

All persons interested in the aforesaid land/lands on which a Servitude is to be acquired are hereby required to appear personally, or by agents duly authorized in writing, before me at the Divisional Secretariat office of Kuruwita on the 06th day of July in 2015 at 9.00 a.m. and are hereby requested to notify to me in writing (in duplicate) on or before the 29th day of June in 2015 of the nature of their interests in the land, the particulars of their claims for compensation for the acquisition of the said land/servitude, the amount of compensation and the details of the computation of such amount.
Divisional Secretary, Kuruwita.
Divisional Secretary’s Office, Kuruwita 06th May, 2015. 06 - 510

NOTICE UNDER SECTION 7 OF LAND ACQUISITION ACT (CHAPTER 460) AS AMENDED BY THE LAND ACQUISITION
(AMENDMENT) ACT, NO. 28 OF 1964 Notice under Section 7
My Reference No. : 06/2/1/178 Land Ministry’s Ref. No. :4-3/06/2013/HW/383.

It is, hereby give notice, that the final date for the submission of documents Pertaining to Title claims and Compensation inquiries to the lands depicted in Preliminary Plan Nos. Ke. 3475, Ke. 3476, Ke. 3477 and Ke. 3478 mentioned in the Extra Ordinary Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka bearing Number 1912/5 dated 28th April 2015, under Section 7 of the Land Acquisition Act, as amended on 15th June 2015.
Accordingly the new date of Title and Compensation inquiries would be amended on 22nd June 2015.
P. UDAKARA, Divisional Secretary, Warakapola.
